## Change contract

- [ ] The exact target and protected behavior are identified.
- [ ] This change is on a branch, not a direct write to `main`.
- [ ] Authority/currentness implications are explicit.
- [ ] Relevant tests and validation were run.
- [ ] New dependencies and GitHub Actions are pinned.
- [ ] Secrets, personal credentials, and local environment files are absent.
- [ ] Material OPEN/BLOCKED coordinates remain explicit.
- [ ] Post-merge branch cleanup is appropriate.

## Root cause / reason

Describe the failure, gap, or strict gain this change addresses.

## Verification

List the tests, audit evidence, or runtime receipts that support admission.
